steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1'); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); })()

steps.name: probe-bg
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); const g = window.__r3f?.store?.getState?.(); return JSON.stringify({ backdrop: s.backdrop, hour: s.manualHour, hasBg: !!(g && g.scene && g.scene.background), bgType: g && g.scene && g.scene.background && g.scene.background.constructor && g.scene.background.constructor.name }); })()
